titre: Family allowances in French Guiana (from the 1st child)
resume: In French Guiana, family allowances are paid from just one dependent child. Who is eligible, how to apply, and how they are split under shared residence.
aQuoiCaSert: Family allowances (allocations familiales) help families cover children's everyday expenses. In mainland France, they are only paid from 2 children. In the overseas departments, including French Guiana, special rules apply: an allowance is paid from the first dependent child, with increases linked to the child's age.
quiEstConcerne: Families living in French Guiana with at least one dependent child under 20.
Separated parents whose child lives in shared residence.
Parents who do not yet receive benefits from the Caf (Caisse d'allocations familiales, the family benefits office).
aSavoir: In the DOM (overseas departments), for a family with only one dependent child, a family allowance is paid, with increases linked to the child's age, from age 11 and then raised from age 16 (Cnaf, the national family benefits fund, network letter LR-2026-051 of February 26, 2026).

From 2 children, the rules are the same as in mainland France. Since March 1, 2026, the age-related increase is paid at 18 instead of 14 for children born on or after March 1, 2012, in families with at least 2 children (except for the eldest in a family of 2 children) (Cnaf, LR-2026-051).
For 2 children, the basic amount ranges from €38.07 to €152.25 per month depending on household income (service-public.gouv.fr, checked on June 1, 2026).
The complément familial (family supplement) has different conditions and amounts in the DOM, including French Guiana (service-public.gouv.fr).

Shared residence: parents can choose to split the family allowances, each receiving half, using form cerfa n° 14000. This choice can only be changed after one year, unless the child's residence changes. If the parents disagree, each parent automatically receives a share.

Only family allowances can be split. The Paje (prestation d'accueil du jeune enfant, early childhood benefit), complément familial, housing benefits, back-to-school allowance, family support allowance and AEEH (disabled child education allowance) are paid in full to the designated parent. Exception: since December 1, 2025, each parent can receive the CMG (complément de libre choix du mode de garde, childcare allowance) according to their own situation.

documents.libelle: ID or residence permit of each parent
documents.detail: Valid copy, requested with your first application to the Caf.

documents.libelle: Family record book (livret de famille) or birth certificate of each child
documents.detail: Copy. Certificate free on service-public.gouv.fr or from the town hall (mairie) where the child was born.

documents.libelle: RIB (bank details slip) of the parent receiving the benefits

documents.detail: Copy, downloadable from your account on impots.gouv.fr. Your income is used in the calculation.
Recent copy (bill, rent receipt or certificate of accommodation).

documents.libelle: Judgment or agreement setting shared residence
documents.detail: Copy, to attach to the split form if shared residence was set by the judge or by an agreement.

documents.libelle: Form cerfa n° 14000, declaration in case of shared residence
documents.detail: Signed by both parents if you agree on the split. Keep a copy.

etapes.titre: Register with the Caf if you have not already
etapes.detail: Apply for benefits on caf.fr. If you already receive Caf benefits, simply declare the child's birth or arrival.
Children correctly declared, income up to date, RIB, correct address, family situation (couple, separated, single parent). If you have separated, declare the actual date.

etapes.titre: Shared residence: choose a split or a single beneficiary
etapes.detail: Fill in form cerfa n° 14000 together and send it to the Caf with the judge's decision or the agreement if you have one.
View the details of your payments in your "Mon Compte" account and use the Caf simulator to check the amount.

ou.detail: Reception by appointment in Cayenne, Kourou and Saint-Laurent-du-Maroni. Online procedures in your "Mon Compte" account.

actions.titre: Report any change in family situation to the Caf
